snippet.title: Super Battle Golf | Official Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The chaos is coming to consoles! 

Super Battle Golf launches on Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5 on March 25, with full cross-play and every update included from day one.

Grab your clubs, race your friends to the hole, and do whatever it takes to win. Shoot, sabotage, and send your rivals flying in a golf game where everyone plays at the same time. No turns, no waiting, just pure golf chaos.

Check it out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4028610/Super_Battle_Golf/
